title: Software analysis
description: Binaries in a read-only folder, the agent reaches only its provider; capa, FLOSS, radare2, YARA, binwalk, jadx and CFR as MCP servers in containers of their own.

de.title: Software-Analyse
de.description: Binärdateien in einem nur lesbaren Ordner, der Agent erreicht nur seinen Anbieter; capa, FLOSS, radare2, YARA, binwalk, jadx und CFR als MCP-Server in eigenen Containern.

prompt: Analyse the samples in /mnt/samples: what each one is, what it can do (capa), its strings (FLOSS), its structure (radare2), YARA matches; Android apps and Java archives decompiled with jadx and CFR. The MCP servers see the samples folder as /work (/mnt/samples/a.exe is /work/a.exe there). Never run a sample. Write one report per sample to /work/reports/.
notes: Samples stay read-only and the agent reaches only its provider: nothing it finds can call home.

capa, FLOSS, radare2, YARA, binwalk, jadx and CFR each run in a container of their own, without network, and get the samples folder read-only at their /work for this start (--mcp-mount NAME:/work=FOLDER:ro). capa, radare2, binwalk, jadx and CFR are sandbox-ai-mcp's reviewed builds (mcp:), FLOSS and YARA axross-mcp-hub's (hub:). jadx needs 2g memory, CFR 1g (sandbox-ai mcp add applies the catalog's limits).
